card.name: End of drug-interaction table titles
card.fires_on: The last word of a table title about drug interactions, such as "Other Drugs" or "Drug Interactions", right before the table rows begin with drug names or classes.

modes.label: Other Drugs
modes.description: The word Drugs ends a title like "Effect of X on Other Drugs".
modes.example: Table 8: Effect of TURALIO on Other<< Drugs>> CYP3A Substrates Clinical

modes.label: Interactions or product name
modes.description: The title ends on Interactions, a product name, or a salt or form word just before the table content.
modes.example: Table 1: Dosage Modifications for Drug Inter<<actions>> Concomitant Drug LYNKU

card.plain: It marks the end of a drug-interaction table heading, just before the table's first row of drugs.
